notes: Corrected: the accepted alignment gave that men commit whole to הָאָדָם under rule 19. Rule 20's lexical-verb boundary inside a nominal recasting reaches this construction — a construct relation licenses the English relational word but not a supplied lexical verb — so commit is now its own added unit and the rectum keeps that men.
The demonstrative that of הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא is placed on הִוא, leaving both articles unrepresented (rule 18's closing case, matching NUM.5.31).
מִן is unrepresented because the present כֹּל is what the determiner any renders (rule 15).
